title: Role Immersion — Rapid Assimilation Toolkit
content:
Purpose:
Quick, repeatable template to convert an offer into a high-probability success for entry-level and lateral hires (IC2–IC4). Focuses on 0–90 day assimilation via role-focused immersion, buddy rotation, and measurable micro-deliverables.

Audience:
- Hiring managers (eng/product/sre)
- People Ops / People Partners
- Hiring panel leads and mentors

When to use:
- Post-offer acceptance planning (auto-run within 48h)
- For hires that need fast cross-team context (platform infra, console, serving runtime)
- As an alternative to the full 120-day onboarding for hires expected to land product-impact in 45–90 days

Scope / Non-goals:
- Includes people/process checklist, interview signals to pass forward, and condensed 90-day deliverables.
- Does NOT replace security on-boarding (see private-deployments-preboard-security-hardware-checklist).

Quick summary (TL;DR):
- 48h: role immersion plan created and shared; access requests filed; mentor (buddy) assigned
- Week 1: environment setup, shadow 3 feature owners, finish 2 training modules, complete first tiny PR or doc update
- Days 15–30: own a small bug/fix or infra task; demo to manager
- Days 31–90: deliver a scoped product/infra increment, run a knowledge share, pass ramp-review score >= 3.8

Hiring plan inputs (to fill before Day 0):
- Expected outcomes (3 bullets): what the hire should deliver by day 90
- Primary mentor / buddy name + backup
- Access list (git, cloud project, infra, datastores) with owners and ticket links
- Training modules (IDs from LMS) and expected completion dates
- Communication cadence (1:1 weekly, buddy daily standup first 2 weeks)

Interview rubric (panel -> hiring packet):
- Score scale: 1 (no), 2 (weak), 3 (meets bar), 4 (strong), 5 (exceptional)
- Dimensions: role-skill (task execution), system sense (tradeoffs/design), collaboration & ownership, learning velocity, culture fit (customers-first, reliability mindset)
- Quick weight guidance (example for IC3 eng): role-skill 35%, system sense 25%, collaboration 20%, learning velocity 10%, culture fit 10%
- Red flags to call out in packet: inability to explain a non-trivial system, defensive answers to feedback, repeated gaps on unit-testing/testing mindset, unclear ownership examples

Sample role-specific probes (copy/modify per role):
- Serving-runtime eng: "Walk me through how you'd reduce tail latency for a 99.9th percentile token pipeline." Follow-ups: metrics to track; safe fallback options; rollbacks.
- Console PM/ENG: "Describe a rollout plan for a per-route model pinning feature with canary and auto-fallback."
- Platform SRE: "How would you design autoscaling policy for dedicated GPU pools with burst capacity? How to test it?"

Panel choreography (practical notes):
- Pre-interview: shared doc with expected probing areas and a 1-paragraph role-context (PM/manager writes).
- 10-minute handoff between interviewers at top of panel (outline to last interviewer).
- Interviewers add 1–2 sentence signal in the packet after each interview + 1 recommended hire/no-hire decision and a 3-point justification.

Decision matrix & thresholds:
- Pass if panel average >=3.4 and no single dimension <2 (for role at-barke).
- Strong-hire: panel avg >=4.2 and >1 signals of exceptional execution or leadership.
- Escalate to hiring council if conflicting signals (one 5 and one 1).

Candidate experience checklist (to send within 24h post-interview):
- Thank-you note from hiring manager + clear timeline
- Short writeup of next steps (offer negotiation window, start date options)
- Onboarding teaser: first-week agenda + buddy intro

Onboarding (0–90) condensed checklist:
Day -3 to 0:
- Create role-immersion packet in Drive + onboarding calendar invite
- File access requests (IAM/GCP/AWS, repo access) - owners assigned
- Order equipment + VPN provisioning ticket
- Buddy assigned & intro email scheduled

Week 1 (Day 0–7):
- Day 0: welcome sync (manager + buddy) 60m. runbook: quick wins, what success looks like
- Env setup checklist: git creds, local dev env, docker images pulled, test dataset access.
- Shadow list: 3 owners (infra, product owner, support triage) — schedule 30–60m each
- Training: Security 101 (mandatory), Infra 101 (team-specific), PR review process module
- Tiny hands-on: open tiny PR (fix doc, flake, test) — ship by day 3

Weeks 2–4 (Day 8–30):
- Ownership of small ticket: deliver end-to-end (write tests, deploy to staging)
- Weekly demos to manager (15m) + buddy-led org tour
- Feedback checkpoint at day 14 (15m) — formalize mitigations if any

Days 31–90:
- Scope & deliver a 2–4 week increment (feature or infra task) with product/infra acceptance criteria
- Host knowledge-share: 20–30m brown bag on what was learned/done
- Ramp review at day 75–90: panel (manager, buddy, cross-team engineer) with scoring on deliverables and collaboration metrics

Mandatory access & compliance TODOs (owner: IT/Security):
- KMS access request (if private deployment contact)
- Signed NDA + code-of-conduct ack
- MFA enforced on day 0

Buddy rotation model (first 30 days):
- Week 1: daily 30m quick syncs
- Week 2: alternate days 30m for shadow pairing on tickets
- End of Week 4: hand-off to longer-term mentor (if required)

Deliverables and success metrics (what to measure):
- Time-to-first-PR: target < 3 days
- Time-to-independent-merge: target < 30 days (CI passing without direct owner intervention)
- Ramp score at 90: avg >=3.8 across panel (delivery, ownership, collaboration)
- Retention flag check at 120 days

Feedback & remediation loop:
- Day 14 and Day 45 soft-checks (manager to upload short notes to packet)
- If any dimension <3 at day 45 => 30-day remediation plan with clear goals, owner, and weekly checkpoints

Templates to attach (quick links):
- Role-immersion template (Drive): /Role-Immersion/Templates/entry-level-immersion.md
- Interview packet template: /Hiring/Templates/interview-packet.md
- Ramp review form: /People-Ops/Forms/ramp-review-90d.csv

Open questions / TODOs:
- Decide whether to require a peer-coded-pairing session for all IC3 hires (ops cost vs. signal). (Owner: eng-dx)
- Add a discrete eval for testing/CI hygiene in interview rubric? (Owner: research applied-ml)
- Localize onboarding modules for EMEA timezone hires (need translation or core hours content). (Owner: people-ops intl)

Quick links / artifacts referenced during runway:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PE/Role+Immersion+Library
- Jira: HR-2345 (onboarding automation epic)
- GitHub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eng-onboarding/pull/78
- Slack: #people-ops, #eng-onboard

Contact & escalation:
- Owner: Ava Martinez (people-ops) — ava.m@redwood.ai
- Backup: Jing Wu (people-ops) — jing.w@redwood.ai
- Hiring council triage (if needed): hiring-council@redwood.ai

Notes to self (informal):
- keep packet <2 pages; busy managers won't read long docs
- get manager to write the 1-paragraph role-context before interviews start
- prefer demo-first evaluation for infra roles (shows end-to-end thinking)

Last edits: condensed Week 1 tiny-PR requirement to ensure early wins and confidence building.
